reason: My register has never crashed and never needed a phone call on a Sunday rush. The price is fine and the person answering 7 days sounds good, but I don't want to change how my counter runs just because an app promises to be faster.
objection: On a packed Sunday with ten customers waiting, if the app hangs or a stylist forgets how to use it, I lose bills and money. With the register, nothing stops working. And a WhatsApp reply is not the same as someone standing in my salon.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run on a busy Sunday in another established Bhubaneswar salon my size, and being allowed to keep my register going alongside it for the first month without losing my money back.
